timeline.tweet: No idea, too scared of the result if I work it out😂
No, but when I was diagnosed with depression I quit as my job was the trigger for it.

I would love to but for very personal reasons I am not ready to yet. I am doing very well now, largely because I made the decision to quit and seek the treatment I needed. I would urge anyone who is depressed and whose job is suffering to talk to their employer and get prof. Help
And my job means I am faced with the kind of people and situations now, that triggered my depression in the past. What has changed is my ability to deal with that.

Depression IS curable! I am living proof of that. After 2 years of meds and therapy I have not once fallen into dark times again. If I do it will be because of something new. But I am so much better able to ward myself against the causes of depression now.
Alcohol is a depressant, depression drives the need to drink. A real circle-of-doom. Giving up the booze helps you fight the depression. You can do it, trust in yourself.
